name: Face Your Fears
source:
I’ve always been scared – of the dark, of heights, of people. Two years ago, it all became too much, and I broke.

But breaking isn’t the end. Slowly, I’m learning to live again.

[From [url=https://jojful.itch.io/face-your-fears]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我一直很害怕——害怕黑暗、害怕高处、害怕人。两年前，这一切变得太过分了，我崩溃了。

但打破并不是结束。慢慢地，我又学会了生活。

[来自[url=https://jojful.itch.io/face-your-fears]Itch.io[/url]]
